---
title: "parvovirus B19 tree"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# load libraries
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
source(here::here("src/parse_sample_id.R"))
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
```


```{r}
gb_meta <- fread(
  here::here("data/b19_phylo/parvovirus_b19.genbank.260715.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = T
) |>
  rename(label = Accession)
```


```{r}
old_donor_meta_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/donors/simple_donor_meta1.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
complete_meta_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/complete/brain_virome_metadata.v5.xlsx")
) |>
  mutate(
    sample_ID = case_when(
      Pool == "p1733" ~ Alt_ID2,
      Pool == "p1849" ~ Alt_ID2,
      Pool == "p1894" ~ gsub("_B", "_1B", Alt_ID2),
      TRUE ~ Barcode
      ),
    tissue = `Brain Region\r\n`
    )
```

```{r}
jp2 <- read.jplace(here::here("data/b19_phylo/epang_attempt_1000nt/epa_result.jplace"))

```

```{r}
ggtree(jp2, layout = "rectangular") + geom_tippoint(aes(size = nplace, color = nplace), alpha = 0.6)
```


```{r}
tr2 <- read.tree(here::here("data/b19_phylo/epang_attempt_1000nt/epa_result.newick"))
```

```{r}
ggtree(tr2, layout = "rectangular") + geom_tippoint(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_tiplab()
```


```{r}
tipanno <- tibble(label = tr2$tip.label) |>
  left_join(gb_meta, by = "label") |>
  mutate(Genotype = case_when(
    is.na(Genotype) ~ "this study",
    Genotype == "" ~ "GenBank unlabeled",
    TRUE ~ toupper(Genotype)
    ),
    mlab2 = case_when(
      grepl("_consensus", label) ~ gsub("NC_", "", label),
      TRUE ~ label
    ),
    mlab2 = str_remove(mlab2, "^[^_]*_"),
    mlab2 = gsub("_consensus$", "", mlab2),
    mlab2 = case_when(
      grepl("XX-0", mlab2) ~ str_replace(mlab2, "^([^-]*-[^-]*).*$", "\\1"),
      grepl("HELTHY|MODAD|SEVAD|H-H", mlab2) ~ str_remove(mlab2, "\\..*"),
      TRUE ~ mlab2
    )
  ) 

tip_fmt_dt <- tipanno |>
#  mutate(
#    sample_ID = gsub("-A$", "", mlab2),
#    sample_ID = case_when(
#      sample_ID == "SEVAD_BF5" ~ "SEVAD_2BF5",
#      sample_ID == "SEVAD_BH5" ~ "SEVAD_1BO5",
#      sample_ID == "SEVAD_BO5" ~ "SEVAD_1BO5",
#      TRUE ~ sample_ID
#    )
#    ) |>
  mutate(
    sample_ID = case_when(
      grepl("_consensus", label) ~ gsub("NC_", "", label),
      TRUE ~ label
    ),
    sample_ID = str_remove(sample_ID, "^[^_]*_")
  ) |>
  separate(sample_ID, c("sample_ID", "Pool"), sep = "[.]") |>
  mutate(
    sample_ID = gsub("-A$", "", sample_ID),
    sample_ID = gsub("-B$", "", sample_ID),
    sample_ID = gsub("-C$", "", sample_ID)
  )
```

```{r}
anti_join(
  tip_fmt_dt,
  complete_meta_dt,
  by = "sample_ID"
)
```



```{r}
tip_mergeo <- merge(
  tip_fmt_dt,
  complete_meta_dt,
  by = "sample_ID",
  all.x = T
) |>
  mutate(est_birth_year = case_when(
    !is.na(`Year of Death`) ~ `Year of Death` - Age,
    TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    big_label = case_when(
      !is.na(Diagnosis) ~ paste(est_birth_year, Diagnosis, sep = ", "),
      TRUE ~ NA
      )
    ) |>
  relocate(sample_ID, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
is.waive <- function(x) inherits(x, "waiver")

po <- ggtree(tr2, layout = "roundrect", size = 0.3) %<+% tip_mergeo

po1 <- po +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(color = Genotype),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = big_label),
              size = 2, offset = 0.002, align = FALSE) +
  theme_tree2() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("cadetblue", "lightblue",
               "purple", "grey", "#9B6981"
               )
  )

po1
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  here::here("charts/parvo_b19_tree_1000nt_2.pdf"),
  po1,
  width = 8,
  height = 11
)
```




# NS1 gene tree
```{r}
nstree1 <- read.tree(here::here("data/b19_phylo/ns_epang/epa_result.newick"))
```

```{r}
ggtree(nstree1, layout = "rectangular") + geom_tippoint(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_tiplab()
```


```{r}
nstree1$tip.label <- gsub("_NS", "", nstree1$tip.label)

ns_tipann <- tibble(label = nstree1$tip.label) |>
  left_join(gb_meta, by = "label") |>
  mutate(Genotype = case_when(
    is.na(Genotype) ~ "this study",
    Genotype == "" ~ "GenBank unlabeled",
    TRUE ~ toupper(Genotype)
    ),
    mlab2 = case_when(
      grepl("_consensus", label) ~ gsub("NC_", "", label),
      TRUE ~ label
    ),
    mlab2 = str_remove(mlab2, "^[^_]*_"),
    mlab2 = gsub("_consensus$", "", mlab2),
    mlab2 = case_when(
      grepl("XX-0", mlab2) ~ str_replace(mlab2, "^([^-]*-[^-]*).*$", "\\1"),
      grepl("HELTHY|MODAD|SEVAD|H-H", mlab2) ~ str_remove(mlab2, "\\..*"),
      TRUE ~ mlab2
    )
  ) 

```

```{r}
tip_merge_ns <- merge(
  ns_tipann,
  old_donor_meta_dt,
  by.x = "mlab2",
  by.y = "join_col",
  all.x = T
) |>
  mutate(big_label = paste(Collection_Date, AD_status, age_at_death, sep = " ")) |>
  relocate(mlab2, .after = last_col())
```






```{r}
is.waive <- function(x) inherits(x, "waiver")

po_ns <- ggtree(nstree1, layout = "roundrect", size = 0.3) %<+% tip_merge_ns

po_ns1 <- po_ns +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(color = Genotype),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  #geom_tiplab(aes(label = big_label),
  #            size = 2, offset = 0.002, align = FALSE) +
  theme_tree2() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("cadetblue", "lightblue",
               "purple", "grey", "#9B6981"
               )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Parvovirus B19 NS gene tree"
  )

po_ns1
```


```{r}
ggsave(
  here::here("charts/parvo_b19_NS_gene_tree_1.pdf"),
  po_ns1,
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)
```
